overview.title: Admin Overview
overview.description: A quick glance at your system.
overview.debugWarning: Jexactyl is running in debug mode. Do not use in production.
overview.enableAutoUpdateDesc: By setting up automatic updates, you can keep Jexactyl stable and secure in the background.
overview.allowRegistrationDesc: Enabling the Authentication module allows users to signup via the login page.
overview.addFirstNodeDesc: Nodes are physical servers which Jexactyl's servers run on.
overview.createFirstServerDesc: Create a server to host your favourite game or program.
overview.donateDesc: Support the project by leaving a donation to help us pay for testing servers and domains.
overview.betaWarning: You are running a beta release of Jexactyl v4, which may include several bugs or weird glitches. Do NOT use this software in production unless you don't care about losing data.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: All servers available on the system.
servers.allocationLimitDesc: The total number of allocations a user is allowed to create for this server.
servers.backupLimitDesc: The total number of backups that can be created for this server.
servers.databaseLimitDesc: The total number of databases a user is allowed to create for this server.
servers.subuserLimitDesc: The total number of subusers that can be added to this server.
servers.cpuLimitDesc: Each thread on the system is considered to be 100%. Setting this value to 0 will allow the server to use CPU time without restriction.
servers.cpuPinningDesc: Advanced: Enter the specific CPU cores that this server can run on, or leave blank to allow all cores. This can be a single number, and or a comma seperated list, and or a dashed range. Example: 0, 0-1,3, or 0,1,3,4. It is recommended to leave this value blank and let the CPU handle balancing the load.
servers.memoryLimitDesc: The maximum amount of memory allowed for this container. Setting this to 0 will allow unlimited memory in a container.
servers.diskLimitDesc: This server will not be allowed to boot if it is using more than this amount of space. If a server goes over this limit while running it will be safely stopped and locked until enough space is available. Set to 0 to allow unlimited disk usage.
servers.blockIODesc: Advanced: The IO performance of this server relative to other running containers on the system. Value should be between 10 and 1000.
servers.oomKillerDesc: Enabling the Out of Memory Killer may cause server processes to exit unexpectedly.
servers.billingDisabledWarning: The Billing Module is currently disabled. Any changes made here will not have effect unless the module is enabled again.
servers.reinstallSuccess: This server will begin the reinstallation process now.
servers.reinstallWarning: Are you sure you wish to reinstall this server now? This could lead to a loss of data or files becoming corrupted by the install process.
servers.reinstallDesc: This will reinstall the server with the assigned service scripts.
servers.suspendWarning: Are you sure you wish to suspend this server? It will become instantly inaccessible to the owner.
servers.suspendServerDesc: This will suspend the server, stop any running processes, and immediately block the user from being able to manage their server through the panel.
servers.unsuspendWarning: Are you sure you wish to unsuspend this server? Users will now be able to reconnect as usual.
servers.unsuspendDesc: This action will allow users to access the server like normal.
servers.installToggleSuccess: This server's install state has been toggled.
servers.installToggleFailed: Failed to change server install state
servers.installToggleWarning: Are you sure you wish to change the install status of this server?
servers.installToggleDesc: Change the server from being in an installed state to uninstalled, or vice versa. Your server is currently marked as

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Update settings and manage user tickets.
tickets.systemDescription: Jexactyl's ticket interface allows your users to create tickets for support on the panel. Users can create, update and view tickets which admins can reply to and mark as a certain status. This feature can be toggled at anytime to suit your business' needs.
tickets.maxCountDesc: If you wish, you can set a maximum amount of tickets that a user can create.
tickets.changesRefresh: These changes may not apply until users refresh the page.

links.title: Custom Links
links.description: Create custom links to external sites for clients.
links.linkNameDesc: Give the link a friendly name which clients can read.
links.linkUrlDesc: This is the URL which the link points to outside of the Panel.
links.linkVisibilityDesc: Toggle this setting to 'on' if you want to allow users to view and use this link. You can change this setting to 'off' at any time.
links.deleteLinkWarning: Are you sure you wish to delete this custom link? Users will no longer be able to use it.

billingExceptions.title: Billing Exceptions
billingExceptions.description: View and resolve errors generated by the billing interface.

theme.title: System Theme
theme.description: View and update the theme of this interface.
theme.resetWarning: Performing this action will immediately wipe all of your custom theming settings. Only do this if you wish to return to the stock appearance of Jexactyl. This action cannot be reversed.

ai.title: Jexactyl AI
ai.geminiWarning: Jexactyl AI relies on Google Gemini models for requests. Information provided could be inaccurate or outdated. Use with caution!
ai.rateLimitWarning: API requests are limited on Gemini's public API to 120/second - if you experience ratelimiting, you may need to upgrade your license.
ai.disableDescription: Clicking the button below will disable Jexactyl AI for both clients and administrators. Your API key will remain in the database unless you choose to delete it manually.
ai.allowUsersAi: Allow standard users to use AI?
ai.allowUsersAiDesc: If enabled, standard Jexactyl users will be able to interact with Jexactyl AI as well as administrators.
ai.modifyApiKeyDesc: If you are experiencing 'Invalid API Key' errors, you can enter a new one here to reset it.
ai.changesReload: These changes may not apply until this page is reloaded.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Configure and manage the authentication flow for users.
auth.registrationDesc: Toggle whether users can register using the built-in pages.
auth.registrationWarning: Since registration is disabled, OAuth modules like Discord will only allow users to login - not register.
auth.force2faDesc: Toggle whether users must use two-factor authentication.
auth.loginAttemptDesc: Set the maximum amount of attempts a user can make to login before being throttled.
auth.deleteModuleConfirm: Are you sure you wish to delete this module?
auth.jguardDelayDesc: If you wish to automatically approve user signups, this variable can make it so that users cannot access the Panel for a certain period of time in order to prevent bot attacks.
auth.clientIdDesc: Set the Discord Client ID. You can find this in the

auth.onboardingDefaultContent: You can change these at any time in the 'Account' tab.
auth.onboardingContentDesc: Set the description that should be displayed in the Onboarding dialog. You can leave this empty if you wish.
auth.onboarding2faWarning: Since 'Force 2FA' is enabled, a box will be shown to users in the Onboarding dialog which informs users they must enable two-factor to use the Panel.

billingOrders.title: Billing Orders
billingOrders.description: A list of the orders placed on this Panel.
billingOrders.importantInfoText: Pending orders are automatically set to expired and deleted after 7 days, making them no longer visible in the admin area. If you wish to remove billing orders from Jexactyl manually, you must make a database query to do so. Removing orders manually is not recommended.

billingProducts.productsInCategory: A list of the available products in the {{category}} category.

activity.description: Get detailed insights into what actions administrators are performing.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Jexactyl's webhook system can send live updates directly to a URL of your choice - perfect for integration with platforms like Discord™, Slack™ and more. Set what you want to monitor, and a webhook will be sent whenever that event has been triggered. Simple!
webhooks.urlProvided: The webhook URL has already been provided.
webhooks.setUrl: Set the webhook URL to use for sending data.
webhooks.changesApply: These changes will apply as soon you save them.

billingOverview.revenueDescription: Your {{count}} successful orders have generated {{symbol}}{{revenue}} {{code}} over the last {{days}} days.

billingSettings.paypalDescription: Adding PayPal to Jexactyl allows users to purchase products via another channel, improving order success rate and global payment availability.
billingSettings.linkDescription: Adding Link to Jexactyl allows users to purchase products via another channel, improving order success rate and global payment availability.
billingSettings.currencyDescription: Choose a primary currency to charge users.
billingSettings.importExportDescription: Use the below options to either export your current billing configurations, or use the Import button to import a pre-created set of categories and products to Jexactyl.
billingSettings.stripeKeysMissing: Without Stripe API authentication, your billing system will not work. Customers may proceed to the checkout area but will be met with errors unless you add valid API keys which can be obtained through the Stripe dashboard.
billingSettings.resetKeysWarning: By resetting the Stripe API keys saved to the panel, all billing services (such as purchasing or renewing a product) will stop working until new API keys are entered. Are you sure you wish to continue?
billingSettings.disableBillingWarning: Clicking the button below will disable all modules of the billing system - such as subscriptions, server purchasing and more. Make sure that this will not impact your users before disabling.
